html:
Skanderbeg, born George Kastrioti around 1405, was an Albanian lord who led a revolt against the Ottoman Empire from 1443 until his death in 1468, and is the national hero of Albania.

Taken as a boy hostage to the Ottoman court, he became a Muslim and an Ottoman officer, earning the name Iskender Bey, after Alexander. In 1443 he deserted during a battle, seized the fortress of Krujë, returned to Christianity and raised his family's double headed eagle flag. With the League of Lezhë he defeated Ottoman armies again and again and held Krujë through three sieges, one led by Sultan Murad II and one by Mehmed II. Popes hailed him as a champion of Christendom. After his death Albania fell, and Albanians fled to Italy.
